engine.notes: The Overtime Theater and its resident team The Denials are confirmed live and current (Season 20 underway, free public Monday workshops active). No other San Antonio improv organisation could be confirmed: there is no local ComedySportz franchise (comedysportzsa.com and comedysportzsanantonio.com both fail to resolve), and the session's shared web-search budget was exhausted before this city's res

entries.name: The Denials at The Overtime Theater
entries.summary: San Antonio's longest-running improv team, resident at the all-volunteer Overtime Theater, with weekly shows and a free public workshop that feeds the team.
entries.schedule: The Denials every Saturday at 10:30 PM and the 4th Friday of each month; free public workshops Monday nights
signals: Described by the theater as San Antonio's longest-running improv team
Free Monday workshops double as an open path onto the team
Overtime Theater is an all-volunteer 501(c)(3), now in its 20th season
FriendZone showcase (1st/3rd Fridays) features other local improv teams at the same venue
entries.reasons: A genuinely long-running team with its own venue and an open public pathway in, though training is informal rather than a structured class ladder.
